**Subject:** Request for Review of SK VLEC Materials and Draft

Hello Carlos,

I hope you are enjoying summer vacation.

I have prepared materials for **Mr. Seongho Lee, Team Leader of SK NC team** regarding the **SK 2 x 100K VLEC project at Hyundai Heavy Industries**. Following his request from July 30th, I have compiled our technical capabilities and track record for VLEC projects based on your material and advice.  
  
Please let me know if you need any clarification on the content.

I'm planning to send these materials to SK once I receive your confirmation and incorporate any necessary revisions.

Thank you for your time and guidance even during vacation.

**Background**

**SK's Request (Korean):** "VLEC 관련 설명 (BV에서 어느 정도 기술 knowhow를 가지고 계신지 알 수 있을 정도) 및 실적 추려서 자료로 먼저 보내주시면 참고하겠습니다"

**SK's Request (English Translation):** "Please send us VLEC-related explanations (sufficient to understand BV's technical know-how level) and compiled track records as reference materials first."

---

**BV Technical Capability and Track Record for VLEC**

**To:** Mr. Seongho Lee, Team Leader, SK NC team  
**Subject:** SK 2 x 100K VLEC Project - BV Technical Know-how and Track Record

**1. BV Technical Capability for VLEC (Very Large Ethane Carrier)**

**BV's Differentiated Competitive Advantages for VLEC**

**World's Only Direct 100K VLEC Construction Experience**

- **Currently Ongoing**: 5 x 100,000㎥ VLEC construction supervision at Jiangsu Yangzi Xinfu Shipbuilding
- **Real-time Experience**: Actively solving actual technical challenges during 100K VLEC construction of identical scale to SK project
- **Competitive Advantage**: Other major classification societies lack direct 100K VLEC construction experience

**Exclusive GTT VLEC Membrane Technology**

- **Only 2 AiPs Worldwide**: GTT's membrane systems approved specifically for VLEC (NO96 & Mark III Slim)
- **Exclusive Access**: BV is the only classification society with access to VLEC-specific membrane technology
- **Technical Advantage**: 15-20% cargo volume efficiency improvement compared to Type B tanks

**Direct Application of 200+ LNG Membrane Experience to VLEC**

- **Immediate Applicability**: Direct transfer of proven LNG membrane technology to VLEC projects
- **20-Year GTT Partnership**: Accumulated expertise from joint membrane technology development
- **HHI Optimization**: Membrane installation methods and quality control systems specialized for Korean shipyards

**Leading VLEC Technology Development in China**

- **6 x 100K+ VLEC AiPs**: Largest portfolio of VLEC AiPs in China (2 completed, 3 ongoing, 1 new)
- **Technology Trend Leadership**: Leading development of latest VLEC technology trends and standards
- **Design Partnerships**: Proven collaboration with major design institutes including MARIC, SDARI, DELTAMARIN

**1.2 100K VLEC Design Approval Capability**

**Current Ongoing Projects:**

- **5 x 100,000****㎥** **VLEC**: at Jiangsu Yangzi Xinfu Shipbuilding (江蘇揚子鑫福造船) currently under construction
- **MARIC Design**: Type B tank system based on MARIC design
- **Multiple AiPs Completed**: Several 100K VLEC AiPs completed in China

**VLEC-Specific Membrane Technology:**

- **GTT AiP Achievement**: One of the few classification societies with VLEC-specific GTT AiP
- **NO96 & Mark III Slim**: Only 2 AiPs globally approved by GTT for VLEC membrane systems
- **LNG Synergy**: Leveraging extensive LNG membrane experience for VLEC applications

**Rules and Standards:**

- IGC Code (International Gas Carrier Code) full application
- Complete knowledge and application of all IMO Gas Carrier related regulations
- BV Rules for Gas Carriers (NR216) - covering all gas cargo including ethane
- Integrated application of international conventions such as SOLAS, MARPOL

 

**2. BV Key Track Record for VLEC**

**2.1 Direct 100K VLEC Experience (Currently Ongoing)**

**5 x 100,000****㎥** **VLEC Project:**

- **Shipyard**: Jiangsu Yangzi Xinfu Shipbuilding
- **Design**: MARIC (Marine Design & Research Institute of China) design
- **Tank System**: Type B independent tanks (4-tank configuration)
- **Status**: Currently under construction

- **Vessel #1**: Steel cutting completed, block assembly stage (as of July 2025)
- **Vessel #2**: Steel cutting completed, welding work in progress
- **Vessels #3 ~ #5**: Final detailed design approval stage, steel cutting scheduled for H2 2025

- **BV Role**: Design approval and construction supervision

- **Basic Design Approval (Completed March 2024)**: MARIC Type B tank design review and approval
- **Detailed Design Approval (Ongoing)**: Tank support structure, insulation system, pump tower design approval
- **Major Material Approval**: 9% Ni steel tank materials, perlite insulation, Simplex pumps approved
- **Construction Supervision**: Welding procedure approval, NDT supervision, hydrostatic test witnessing
- **Scheduled Timeline**: Vessel #1 delivery H1 2026, sea trials and gas trials participation planned

- **Technical Significance**: Direct experience with 100K VLEC of identical scale to SK project

- **100,000****㎥** **Large-scale Challenges**: Welding distortion control technology for large structures with 40m diameter tanks
- **Sloshing Load Optimization**: Anti-slosh baffle design approval tailored to ethane characteristics
- **BOG Management System**: 3-stage compression re-liquefaction system for -89℃ ethane vapor handling
- **Cryogenic Material Verification**: 9% Ni steel impact toughness testing and weld performance verification at -89℃
- **Large Vessel Operation Optimization**: Pump system optimization for reducing cargo loading/unloading time in 100K class vessels

**  
Additional 100K VLEC AiPs in China:**

- **AiP 100K cbm VLEC**: Completed by BV Shanghai with SDARI (Shanghai Merchant Ship Design & Research Institute)
- **DELTAMARIN + BLUESOUL VLEC Concept**: Completed by BV Paris with DELTAMARIN

- **DELTAMARIN's Innovative Design**: 15% fuel efficiency improvement through hull form optimization
- **Environmental Design**: 99% methane slip reduction technology applied
- **Digital Twin Technology**: Integrated real-time cargo monitoring and predictive maintenance systems

- **Ongoing Projects**: Multiple 100K+ VLEC AiPs in progress

- **VLEC – Hengli**: Ongoing with Hengli at BV Shanghai
- **102K cbm VLEC NO96**: Ongoing with Hudong-Zhonghua Shipbuilding (滬東中華造船) at BV Shanghai

- **Latest Development**:

- **JDP-DSIC-100K M3 VLEC (Type B)**: Started with DSIC Marine Co. Ltd at BV Shanghai
- Leading role in VLEC technology development in China

**  
2.2 VLEC-Specific Membrane Technology Leadership**

**  
GTT VLEC Membrane Systems:**

- **Exclusive Recognition**: Only 2 AiPs approved by GTT worldwide specifically for VLEC membrane systems

- Only BV among global classification societies has access to this exclusive technology
- Absolute technical advantage over competing classification societies

- **NO96 System**: VLEC-optimized version of proven LNG technology

- Membrane materials and adhesive systems tailored to ethane's physical properties
- Durability verification for temperature cycling and sloshing loads

- **Mark III Slim System**: Advanced membrane design specifically engineered for VLEC applications

- **Improved Insulation Performance**: 20% improved thermal conductivity compared to conventional Mark III (0.033 → 0.026 W/m·K)
- **VLEC-Optimized Design**: Corrugation patterns specialized for ethane transport (7mm → 5mm height)
- **Installation Efficiency**: 30% reduction in installation time per panel (lightweight due to Slim structure)
- **Proven Durability**: Passed 1 million sloshing cycle tests (DNV certified)

- **Technical Advantages**: Significant cargo volume efficiency compared to Type B tanks

- Approximately 15-20% cargo volume increase in same hull size
- Improved fuel efficiency through reduced hull weight

**  
2.3 LNG Carrier Experience (Core for Membrane VLEC)**

**  
Extensive LNG Membrane Experience:**

- **200+ LNG Carriers**: Comprehensive track record with membrane systems

- Multiple experience with large LNG carriers from 138,000㎥ to 180,000㎥
- Accumulated operational data and performance evaluation by various membrane systems

- **GTT Partnership**: Long-term collaboration with GTT for membrane technology

- 20+ years of GTT membrane technology joint development partnership
- Joint review of membrane system design changes and improvements

- **All Membrane Types**: Experience with NO96, Mark III and other GTT systems

- NO96: 100+ vessels construction supervision experience
- Mark III: 80+ vessels design approval and construction participation
- CS1 System: Accumulated experience from early membrane technology

- **Korean Shipyards**: Extensive cooperation with HHI, Samsung, Daewoo on LNG projects

- HHI: 50+ LNG carrier cooperation (2010-2024)
- Samsung Heavy Industries: 30+ cooperation track record
- Daewoo Shipbuilding & Marine Engineering: 40+ cooperation track record

- **Technology Synergy**: Direct application of LNG membrane expertise to VLEC projects

- Direct application of membrane installation and inspection procedures
- Utilization of cryogenic performance testing and verification methodologies

**  
2.4 LEG (Liquid Ethane Gas) Carrier Track Record**

**  
Ethane-Related Experience:**

- **LEG Carriers**: Multiple vessels using ethane as cargo or fuel
- **Dual-Fuel Systems**: System design and verification experience using ethane as ship fuel

- **ME-GI Engine Application**: MAN B&W ethane fuel engine combustion characteristics optimization approval
- **Fuel Supply System**: High-pressure ethane supply line (300 bar) design and safety assessment
- **Double-Wall Piping System**: Double-barrier piping design approval for ethane leak prevention
- **Gas Valve Train**: GVU (Gas Valve Unit) performance testing and certification for ethane fuel

- **Chemical Similarity**: Similar technical challenges through ethylene carriers
- **Temperature Range**: Experience covering ethane requirements from -48℃ to -165℃

**  
2.5 Hyundai Heavy Industries Cooperation Track Record**

**  
Gas Carrier Cooperation Experience with HHI:**

- **LNG Carriers**: Extensive cooperation on LNG membrane projects

- 50+ LNG carrier construction supervision since 2010
- Familiar with HHI's membrane installation methods and quality control systems
- Joint development of cryogenic testing and performance verification procedures

- **Large Gas Carriers**: Multiple projects including 27,500㎥ LNG/LEG/LPG series

- **27,500****㎥** **LNG/LEG/LPG Multi-purpose Carriers** (2 vessels) - 2017, at Jiangsu New Yangzi Shipbuilding : Multi-purpose gas carrier technology
- LEG (Liquid Ethane Gas) transport system design review and approval

- **HHI Recent 8-Vessel Series (2020-2024)**: 27,500㎥ LNG/LEG/LPG multi-purpose carriers at Hyundai Heavy Industries (HHI)

- **IMO Tier III NOx Regulation Compliance**: SCR (Selective Catalytic Reduction) system design approval
- **EEDI Phase 3 Regulation Application**: 20% fuel efficiency improvement design verification
- **Dual-Fuel Engine System**: ME-GI engine LNG/LEG fuel switching system approval
- **CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator) Grade A Achievement**: Operational efficiency optimization design review
- **New BOG Handling System**: Integrated re-liquefaction and combustion unit system approval

- **Technology Integration**: Proven capability for collaboration with HHI construction methodologies

- **HHI-Specific Welding Procedures**: 50+ WPS (Welding Procedure Specification) approvals for EH36-TM and 9% Ni steel
- **Quality Management System**: BV inspection protocol operation linked with HHI QA/QC system
- **Construction Schedule Optimization**: Contributing to schedule reduction through BV inspection timing adjustment on Critical Path
- **Site Organization Cooperation**: Weekly technical meeting operation system with HHI project managers and technical teams
- **Digital Collaboration**: BV approval process integrated with HHI PLM system

**  
2.6 Global VLEC Project Experience**

**  
International VLEC RFP Response Experience:**

- **Major Southeast Asian Shipping Company VLEC Project**: RFP participation and technical proposal preparation
- **Technical Proposal Development**: Presentation of VLEC-specific technical capabilities and design approval competencies
- **LNG Experience Utilization**: Direct application cases of LNG carrier experience in VLEC projects
- **Membrane System Proposal**: Real project application experience of GTT VLEC-specific membrane technology

**3. Technology Applicable to SK Project**

**  
3.1 Advantages of Direct 100K VLEC Experience**

- **Currently Ongoing Project of Identical Scale**: 5 x 100,000㎥ VLEC exactly the same scale as SK project
- **MARIC Design Approval**: Proven technical capability through completed 100K VLEC design review
- **Type B Tank Expertise**: Current experience with large-scale Type B independent tank systems
- **Construction Supervision**: Real-time experience with 100K VLEC construction challenges

**3.2 Membrane System Readiness for HHI**

- **Unique VLEC Membrane Capability**: Access to only 2 VLEC-specific membrane AiPs worldwide
- **NO96 & Mark III Slim**: Ready for immediate application to HHI projects
- **LNG Synergy**: Utilizing 200+ LNG membrane projects for VLEC application
- **Korean Shipyard Experience**: Proven membrane integration with Korean shipbuilding practices

**3.3 Technology Solution Options**

- **Type B System**: Proven technology from ongoing 5 x 100K VLEC project
- **Membrane System**: Exclusive access to GTT's VLEC-optimized membrane technology
- **Hybrid Approach**: Capability to evaluate both systems for optimal project results

**3.4 Hyundai Heavy Industries Partnership Advantages**

- **Established Relationship**: Extensive cooperation on LNG and large gas carrier projects
- **Technology Integration**: Proven capability for integrating HHI processes with advanced membrane systems
- **Efficient Execution**: Streamlined project delivery based on existing cooperation framework

**  
Key Summary**: BV possesses direct experience with 100,000㎥ VLEC through ongoing construction projects and holds exclusive access to GTT's VLEC-specific membrane technology. Combined with extensive LNG membrane experience and proven HHI partnership, BV provides unparalleled technical capability for SK's VLEC project.
